solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Pieces of pork, and seconds, eaten with these?

parts.note: pork chops are cuts of pork
a tick is a moment, a second on the clock

explanation.surface: A diner wonders what utensils go with pork pieces and second helpings.
explanation.definitionFit: The question mark marks a definition by description: these sticks are the implements East Asian meals are commonly eaten with.

clue.text: Black bird died in flock

parts.note: the crow is a familiar black bird
D is the standard abbreviation for died, as in genealogies

explanation.surface: A dark bird has dropped dead among a flock of its fellows.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonyms as nouns: a flock and a throng are both large gatherings.

clue.text: Getting on train, Bond shows badge of loyalty

parts.note: someone getting on in years is old
to school someone is to train them
a tie is a bond or link

explanation.surface: Someone boarding a train meets James Bond, who displays a token of allegiance.
explanation.walkthrough: The old school tie, worn by former pupils of a British public school, stands for the loyalty and mutual favours among them.
explanation.definitionFit: Idiom: the neckwear of one's former school is a symbol of allegiance to fellow alumni and the establishment network.

clue.text: Big shots turn over this rogue trader

indicators.note: turn over tells us to read the word for big shots backwards

parts.note: VIPs, very important persons, are big shots

explanation.surface: Wealthy high-fliers hand their money to a crooked dealer.
explanation.walkthrough: A spiv is British slang for a flashy petty crook dealing in black-market goods, especially in the 1940s.
explanation.definitionFit: Slang synonym: a flashy small-time dealer in shady goods is a dishonest trader.

clue.text: Frantic finale is out

definitions.note: said of a tree whose foliage has opened

indicators.note: something frantic is wildly agitated, so the letters of finale are thrown about

explanation.surface: A frenzied ending to a match leaves a player dismissed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'is out' suggests a dismissed player or someone away, but here it describes a tree in springtime.
explanation.definitionFit: A tree that has come out in spring has its foliage open, the botanical sense of being out.

clue.text: Tragedy of monarch at meadow, heading for Runnymede

parts.note: a king is a monarch
lea is a poetic word for a meadow

indicators.note: heading for means the first letter of the following word

explanation.surface: Recalls a royal drama at the riverside meadow of Runnymede, where King John sealed Magna Carta.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: Shakespeare's play about an aged king and his daughters is one of his great tragedies.

clue.text: Vacation axed to work out money-saving scheme

indicators.note: to work out the letters is to rearrange them into a solution

explanation.surface: A cancelled holiday prompts someone to devise a plan to save cash.
explanation.definitionFit: Description: legally arranging affairs to pay less to the revenue is a plan for keeping more money.

clue.text: Handful of hair perhaps that is something for wiping nose

parts.note: a hank is a coil or skein, for example a handful of hair
i.e. is the abbreviation of id est, that is

explanation.surface: Someone clutching a hank of hair asks whether it could serve to blow their nose.
explanation.definitionFit: Description: a small handkerchief is the cloth used for blowing and wiping the nose.

clue.text: Out-of-date announcement for the police?

parts.note: something out of date is old
a bill is a posted notice or announcement

explanation.surface: An outdated public notice is pinned up by the constabulary.
explanation.walkthrough: Old Bill is British slang for the police.
explanation.definitionFit: British slang: the force of officers on the beat is colloquially called by this name.

clue.text: Some loony alarmed antelope

indicators.note: Some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A crazed animal has been frightened.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: the nyala is a spiral-horned antelope of southern Africa.

clue.text: Lowered head for speaking tube

indicators.note: for speaking tells us to go by how the word for lowered head is pronounced

parts.note: to duck is to lower the head quickly

explanation.surface: Someone bowed to talk into a voice pipe on a ship.
explanation.walkthrough: 'speaking tube' looks like one item, but the definition is only 'tube'.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a channel or pipe carrying air or liquid is a tube.

clue.text: Everything in hot gospel is a sign of quality

indicators.note: in places the word for everything within the other letters

parts.note: H is the abbreviation for hot, as on taps
Mark is one of the four gospels
everything means all

explanation.surface: Fervent preaching carries the stamp of excellence.
explanation.definitionFit: A hallmark is literally the assay stamp on silver and gold, hence any mark of quality.

clue.text: For short film, right supplier

parts.note: pro means for, in favour of

indicators.note: short says the word for film loses its final letter

parts.note: a video is a film

explanation.surface: A buyer seeks the right vendor for a brief movie.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: one who provides goods or services supplies them.

clue.text: Two couples eating large meal

indicators.note: eating means the number swallows the letter for large

parts.note: two pairs make four
L is the abbreviation for large, as on clothing

explanation.surface: Four diners, two pairs, are tucking into a big dinner.
explanation.walkthrough: 'meal' looks like a dinner, but it means ground grain.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: meal is grain ground to powder, just as wheat is milled for baking.

clue.text: Cheat's set of papers opened by doctor

definitions.note: read as cheat is: a cheat, a swindle, is the answer

indicators.note: opened by means the papers word is split with the doctor's letters inside

parts.note: a file is a folder holding a set of papers
DD is Doctor of Divinity

explanation.surface: A fraudster's dossier has been examined by a physician.
explanation.walkthrough: The 's after Cheat stands for 'is', joining definition to wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: Informal synonym: a fiddle is a swindle or fraud, so a dishonest dodge.

clue.text: In agreement to make amends

definitions.meaning: ... with someone, read as two words, means in harmony
to repair a wrong or expiate a sin

explanation.surface: Reconciled parties agree to put things right.
explanation.definitionFit: Both senses come from the same root: to be reconciled with someone and to make up for a wrong.

clue.text: Slave turns up with company artwork

indicators.note: turns up in a down clue means the word is read from bottom to top

parts.note: a serf was a feudal labourer bound to the land, like a slave

explanation.surface: A slave arrives with business partners bearing a painting.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a mural painted on wet plaster is a type of artwork.

clue.text: Giving birth — it may be done in a van

definitions.meaning: the act of bringing a baby into the world

definitions.text: it may be done in a van
definitions.meaning: a parcel or goods brought to the door by a courier van

explanation.surface: A baby is born in the back of a van.
explanation.definitionFit: Two senses: the bringing forth of a child, and the handing over of goods to a recipient.

clue.text: A mother? He didn't have one

parts.note: a dam is the mother of an animal, as in horse breeding

explanation.surface: A puzzle about a man who never had a mother.
explanation.walkthrough: In Genesis the first man was made from dust, so he had no mother.
explanation.definitionFit: Allusion: the biblical first man was created directly by God and had no parent at all.

clue.text: Foreign sea — it becomes desert

parts.note: mer is French for sea

explanation.surface: A foreign sea dries up and turns into a desert.
explanation.walkthrough: 'desert' looks like sand dunes but is the noun of 'just deserts', what one deserves.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a desert, as in just deserts, is something earned or deserved, like worth.

clue.text: Exam success? I don't know

definitions.meaning: said in a quiz when declining to answer

explanation.surface: Asked if they did well in the test, someone shrugs.
explanation.definitionFit: Two senses: a satisfactory result in a test, and the quiz word for declining a question.

clue.text: Landowner's manner welcomed by lord

definitions.note: read as landowner is: a Scottish landowner is the answer

indicators.note: welcomed by puts the manner word inside the lord's letters

parts.note: an air is a manner or bearing

explanation.surface: A country squire's bearing is warmly received by a nobleman.
explanation.walkthrough: A laird is a Scottish landed proprietor; the 's means 'is'.
explanation.definitionFit: Scottish term: the owner of a landed estate in Scotland is so called.

clue.text: Pens ran out; that's a wrench

indicators.note: out means the letters are disordered, put out of place

explanation.surface: The pens have run dry, which is a real wrench for the writer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'wrench' looks like an emotional blow but is the tool.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a tool for turning nuts is called a wrench in America and this in Britain.

clue.text: Bolero isn't bad: it's got three stars

indicators.note: bad suggests the letters are spoiled and rearranged

explanation.surface: A reviewer says Ravel's Bolero is decent: three-star rating.
explanation.definitionFit: Description: this asterism is a line of three bright stars across the hunter constellation.
